findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/Lifting.lean:452-460` explicitly states and proves injection on all fundamental-groupoid Hom-sets, “in particular on the fundamental group”; the new proof merely applies it.
findings.fix: Remove this wrapper and use `hp.injective_path_homotopic_map e e` directly at any eventual consumer.
findings.issue: `mapOfEq_injective` is an unused fundamental-group specialization of the stronger existing `IsCoveringMap.injective_path_homotopic_map`.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/GroupTheory/Index.lean:867-870` already proves `(MulAction.stabilizer G x).index = Nat.card X` for every pretransitive action.
findings.fix: Keep the covering-space corollary but prove it by rewriting with `stabilizer_eq_range` and applying `(MulAction.index_stabilizer_of_transitive (FundamentalGroup X x) e).symm`.
findings.issue: `card_fiber_eq_index` rederives the generic transitive-action cardinality result through `fiberEquivQuotientRange`.

summary: Two declarations/proofs duplicate stronger or generic Mathlib results instead of reusing them directly.
